tiering: RUO / hypothesis-generating; no clinical or regulatory claim

pipeline.name: serial_sae_frozen_v1
pipeline.note: Single frozen pipeline applied identically across all cohorts.

hypothesis_under_test: Higher post-treatment (or relapse) pathway activation (DDR primary; PI3K, VEGF secondary) predicts platinum resistance (AUROC>0.5; Spearman rho<0 vs PFI).
success_criterion: signal replicated if post-treatment-state -> resistance holds SAME DIRECTION with frozen pipeline in >=2 independent cohorts beyond BriTROC-1, with effect sizes+CIs; non-replication reported honestly.

cohorts.verdict: PARTIAL/NON-REPRODUCTION: published headline correlation & p NOT reproduced; only delta-null reproduces; post-DDR AUROC 0.75 reproduces ONLY under manuscript 8R/3S labels but CI (0.375-1.0) is uninformative.
cohorts.direction: post-DDR predicted direction under corrected labels but non-significant and CI spans 0.5

cohorts.verdict: POSITIVE (reproduces published exactly) BUT FRAGILE: rests on only 3 resistant patients (EPV=3). Sole positive external cohort.
DOES NOT REPLICATE (OPPOSITE DIRECTION): all pathways higher in SENSITIVE (AUROC<0.5); PI3K nominally significant in opposite direction (p=0.043).
cohorts.caveat: single-timepoint cross-sectional; tests post-state analogue, not serial design directly

cohorts.verdict: CANNOT TEST PREDICTION (no resistance labels). DDR significantly DECREASES post-NACT (p=0.0003) -> pathways dynamically modulated by chemo (mechanistic plausibility only).
PROGNOSTIC ONLY (not serial). Only PI3K associates with worse OS (HR=1.30, p=0.023); DDR/VEGF NS. Different pathway emphasis than discovery; prognostic != serial resistance.
cohorts.direction: PI3K higher -> worse OS (adequately powered, but a different claim)

cohorts.design: paired in-vitro primary ascites cultures pre/post chemo
cohorts.verdict: EXCLUDED: unpublished ShV->GSM sample mapping (13 vs 14 mismatch); in-vitro cultures not tumor tissue; no resistance labels. Forcing a positional mapping would inject an unverifiable assumption.

descriptive_DDR_meta.WARNING: I^2=83% (Q p=0.0025): extreme between-cohort heterogeneity. Pooled value is an artifact of BriTROC-1's dominant weight (a CN signature, not an expression score) and MUST NOT be reported as a pooled result. Report per-cohort only.

cross_cohort_summary.verdict: NON-REPLICATION of the resistance-PREDICTION claim across independent cohorts. BriTROC-1 remains the sole positive and is fragile. Discovery headline stats not reproduced.
